new_results: QFORM-HIGHWINDOW-SCHUR-DESCENT-v1: with P=1_{|A|>=1/64}, any diagonal-dominated P-heavy row in a minimum counterexample to C_*=32768sqrt(2) has |a|>=tau>=1/4 and s_2(S)>=tau.

QFORM-HEAVY-WINDOW-PHYSICAL-COLLAR-v1: partner high-window localization reduces every survivor either to a large physical pivot plus second-level Schur-window localization, or to source-realizable universal cross banks/cross-cut energy.
